items.title: Terry McLaurin: Questionable for Week 5
items.text:
McLaurin (hamstring) was limited at Friday's practice and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tee Higgins: Listed as questionable, FP
items.text:
